common_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production 2D Unity GAME EFFECT ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET, effect-only.
REFERENCE ROLE: the attached bronze Chinese alchemy-furnace enemy is ONLY a palette/linework/cel-shading reference. Do NOT depict the enemy, face, eyes, limbs, furnace body, teapot spout, chest vent hardware, nozzle, lid, handle or weapon. Only the specifically requested fire/steam/shockwave/bomb visual below. A physical bronze BOMB is allowed ONLY in the bomb animation.
MANDATORY COMPOSITION: EXACTLY SIXTEEN sequential effect frames, FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, square1024x1024 RGBA PNG. Sixteen invisible equal256x256 cells. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom; progress continuously across row breaks. Each entire effect INCLUDING ALL smoke, glow, sparks, embers, stones and brass fragments is SMALL inside own cell, at most190px wide/190px tall (use lower requested height for low shockwave). At least24px COMPLETELY EMPTY TRANSPARENT PADDING on ALL FOUR sides of EVERY cell, including outer canvas. Prefer30-40px empty margins. Never touch/overlap/enter another cell or crop glow/particles.
ONE FIXED DRAWING SCALE for the entire animation, fixed local anchor specified below. Early/late effects must naturally be MUCH smaller/weaker than peak; do not zoom individual frames to fill cells. No repeated identical icons. A real one-shot BURST with beginning, peak and dissipation; DO NOT loop back to F1.
Style: clean outlined CEL-SHADED CARTOON effects matching hand-painted bronze Chinese alchemy-furnace faction, strong readable silhouettes and controlled warm highlights. White-hot or warm-white cores, orange heat, brass/bronze tones, warm gray soot or white steam according to effect. No jade magic aura palette.
REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA outside effect and between fragments. NO scenery, background color/gradient, ground texture, floor slab, cast background shadow, opaque smoke rectangle, printed checkerboard, UI, border, grid line, text, frame number, label or watermark. Do not draw any character or source hardware. Do not draw an invisible effect as a colored background cloud.
